headline: Trap Lore Ross Claims $10K Doodie Lo Challenge Reward
body: Trap Lore Ross posted on Instagram that he won a $10,000 reward for the Doodie Lo Challenge, asking if the recipient will accept and do something positive. The post, published September 10, 2026, has garnered 12K likes and 1,124 comments. The Doodie Lo Challenge appears to be a viral social media trend where participants complete tasks to earn cash rewards.
